verdict.rationale: Gmail's docs show search operators that can be combined, filters created from search results, and operators like in:snoozed. Offline search is documented, and one community user reports being able to search an archived message history easily. Speed, result ranking, and explicit full-history coverage are not documented, so only the operators-and-filters core of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: evidence of fast search performance, ranked or relevance-ordered results, explicit coverage of the full mail history, and independent hands-on corroboration of search precision.

support.subject: As a power-user, search is fast and precise — operators, filters, and ranked results across my full mail history

citations.quote: You can also combine operators to filter your results even more.
After you search, you can use the results to set up a filter for these messages.
To search for snoozed emails, at the top, in the search bar, enter `in:snoozed`.
You can use Gmail offline to read, search, and reply to messages without an internet connection.
